selection_notes: Condensed from extracted sender_processor markdown/spec indexes. LED capacities are model-level published loads where available; VX models use 650,000 pixels per 1G output port.

processors.name: U15 Max
processors.overview: Modular video splicer with up to 520 million pixels through 10G fiber, 472 million pixels through 5G Ethernet, or 262 million pixels through 1G Ethernet output boards.

processors.name: U9 Max
processors.overview: Modular video splicer for large LED projects with 10G fiber, 5G Ethernet, and 1G Ethernet output board options.

processors.name: U6 Max
processors.overview: Modular video splicer for medium and large projects with 10G fiber, 5G Ethernet, and 1G Ethernet output board options.

processors.name: Z8t
processors.overview: Z8t (Specification V2.1): 5G Ethernet output to receiving cards; swappable boards, max 23.59M pixels (16,384 px width). Example: XFIPHX4V103 with 4×5G Neutrik ports per board, up to 2 output boards. Video 8/10/12-bit, 23.98–240 Hz; HDR10/HLG.

outputs.label: 5G Ethernet output boards (e.g. XFIPHX4V103: 4×5G/board, up to 2 boards)

processors.name: VX20
processors.overview: All-in-one video controller with 20 1G Ethernet output ports and 13 million pixels total load at 8-bit 60 Hz.

processors.name: VX12F
processors.overview: All-in-one video controller with 12 1G Ethernet-class outputs and 7.86 million pixels total load.

processors.name: VX10
processors.overview: All-in-one video controller with 10 1G Ethernet output ports.

processors.name: VX6
processors.overview: All-in-one video controller with 6 1G Ethernet output ports.
